demoCaption: Default replies with sample names and numbers. Your saved messages can differ.
metaDesc: Give Twitch viewers channel loyalty points for watch time, subs and cheers. Customize earning rates, manage balances, and enable Gamble and Duels.
title: Give your regulars a channel currency.
lead: ItsBagelBot is a Twitch loyalty points bot with a currency you name. Viewers earn for time in chat while you are live, subscriptions, gifted subs and cheers. They can check balances, send points and play Gamble or Duels when you enable those games.
howTitle: Set the currency your chat earns.
step1Desc: Open Loyalty in the dashboard and turn on the currency. Choose its name and the earning rates for your channel.
step2Desc: Decide whether viewers can transfer points and whether moderators can set or adjust balances. The streamer retains those controls.
step3Desc: Enable Gamble or Duels from Loyalty if you want chat to wager points. Both games use the same balance and require loyalty to stay on.
tblNote: !points and !watchtime have five-second cooldowns; !leaderboard has ten seconds. Transfers and moderator balance changes follow your channel settings. !duel accept and decline belong to the challenged viewer; cancel belongs to the opener or a moderator.
listTitle: A balance that follows your channel.
item1Desc: Viewers present in chat earn on a five-minute tick while the channel is live. The default award is ten points per tick.
item2Desc: Defaults award 500 for a subscription or resubscription, 100 per gifted sub and 50 per 100 bits. Subscription tiers multiply sub, resub and gifted sub awards.
item3Desc: The default win chance is 50 percent, with bets from 1 to 1000 points and a ten-second cooldown per viewer. Odds, limits and cooldown are configurable.
item4Desc: Pot duels draw a winner weighted by stake. A one-to-one challenge matches equal stakes and settles with a fair coin flip.
limitsNote: These are ItsBagelBot loyalty points. Gamble and Duels spend that currency. Pot entries default to a sixty-second window; challenge acceptance defaults to two minutes.
prereq1: Connect the bot to your Twitch channel and enable Loyalty.
prereq2: Enable Gamble and Duels separately before using their commands, and give viewers a balance to wager.
faqQ1: How do viewers check their loyalty points?
faqA1: Use !points to see a balance and watched hours. !watchtime shows accrued watch time. !leaderboard, also available as !top, shows the channel standings.
faqQ2: Can I name the points and change the earning rates?
faqA2: Yes. Choose the currency name and tune awards for subscriptions, resubscriptions, gifted subs, cheers and watch ticks in Loyalty.
faqQ3: Can moderators give points to viewers?
faqA3: Yes, when moderator adjustments are enabled. !points add and !points remove change a balance; !points set replaces it when moderator setting is enabled. The streamer can use these controls even when moderator access is off.
faqQ4: Does !gamble all always wager the entire balance?
faqA4: It wagers up to the configured maximum bet. !gamble half also respects that maximum. A wager must meet the minimum and fit the available balance.
faqQ5: What happens to points when a duel is cancelled?
faqA5: Cancellation refunds escrowed stakes. Declining a challenge or letting its acceptance window expire refunds the opener. Only the challenged viewer can accept or decline; the opener or a moderator can cancel.
